description: IANA timezone of a point (timezone-boundary-builder polygons: land and territorial waters) with the current UTC offset, DST flag and local time; match is none on the open sea. `dst` is true when the zone's clocks are advanced at that instant: its offset is the larger of the two it shows in that year (1 January and 1 July); a zone with one offset all year is never DST (Morocco: +01:00 and the +00:00 of Ramadan are both `dst: false`). When zones share an edge or overlap, `ambiguous` is true, `timezone` and the other fields are the first zone by name and `candidates` lists all of them (each with its own offset, dst and local time). 503 NOT_READY on a dataset built before the feature. Needs an API key: the MCP client sends `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180.
